title: Biogenic zinc titanate nanoparticles in plant tissue culture: micropropagation of Clitoria ternatea and molecular docking against pathogens
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01064K, Paper
Heena Peethambaran, Nisha George, Sohini Chakraborty, Viji M. O., Vidhya Thomas K.
Green-synthesized ZnTiO3 NPs (3 mg mL−1) enhanced germination, growth, chlorophyll, and antifungal activity in Clitoria ternatea, offering a sustainable approach for in vitro micropropagation and resilient agriculture.
